worldattribute-wmapSharedChart-desc: Send predicted terrain to every player; the game chart hides unexplored areas. A modified client could reveal them. Off: ordinary players see only their recorded terrain. Changes apply after restarting the world.
worldattribute-wmapExploreBySight-desc: Chart terrain visible over the ground, with a small circle around you. Off: chart the exploration-radius circle. Needs shared predicted terrain; otherwise circle exploration applies. Changes apply after restarting the world.
